title: Tokenized Security Lifecycle Validator
description: Validate issuance, corporate actions, and maturity/redemption lifecycle for tokenized securities on Daml/Canton. Checks Daml contract coverage against required lifecycle events by security type. EU DLT Pilot Regime eligibility and prospectus obligation checks.
